set policy-options prefix-list NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-PREFIXES 203.0.113.1/32
set policy-options prefix-list NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-PREFIXES 203.0.113.2/32
set policy-options policy-statement NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-POLICY term match from prefix-list NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-PREFIXES
set policy-options policy-statement NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-POLICY term match then accept
set policy-options policy-statement NETOPS-JUNOS-SYSTEM-SERVICES-POLICY term default then reject
